messages.subject: Re: Convergence problem with SEM
parts:
On 10/09/2016 11:08 PM, Liz Eisenhauer wrote:
> I am trying to use SEM, but the model will not converge (see below). I
> used the same model with different data previously and it converged, but
> I am having a problem with this dataset. How can I get the model to
> converge?

It may not be possible, given the data. Do the indicators of the factor
P1 have enough information in common (ie are they highly correlated?).
Same for P3?

All you can do is to manually 'fix' parameters (in particular variances)
to a reasonable constant (perhaps based on other runs with different
data), until you get convergence, but if the data is too far away from
the model, it may never work.

Yves.
